svg.aria-label: Every way repo-spend's band can look: four widths in the terminal and the desktop app, while history loads or fails, the burn's states, how far back the history reaches, and pricing
svg.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Every way repo-spend's band can look: four widths in the terminal and the desktop app, while history loads or fails, the burn's states, how far back the history reaches, and pricing
svg.text: Widths in the terminal: the richest layout that fits is drawn
Wide, 112+ columns: totals, today, last 7 days, the sparkline
Medium, 93–111 columns: the 7-day figure goes first
Compact, 71–92 columns: short totals, the sparkline goes
Tiny, under 71 columns: just the numbers
Widths in the desktop app: the same cut-offs, sans text and SVG bars
Wide: totals, today, last 7 days, the sparkline
Compact: short totals, the sparkline goes
Before the history is ready (no sparkline until it is)
First scan, while there is room for the repo name
No python3 on PATH: past sessions are skipped, the live one still shows
The scan failed for another reason
This session's burn over the last 30 minutes
The first minute: no pace or sparkline yet
How far back the history reaches (rounded up)
Under a day: today and the last 7 days would repeat the total, so they go
Under a week: the 7-day figure goes
Up to 31 days: counted in days
Up to 24 months: counted in months
A model with no known price: + after the total, and the model named (wide layout only)
Type /repo-spend to hide the band and again to bring it back; it also steps aside while a survey shows
